title: Travel with expert guides
text: Our visit to the Gaudi Houses was very rewarding, and the guide Andrés Reyes's experience and knowledge of the area were magnificent; I have traveled to Barcelona many times, but until now, I hadn't really known it.
author: ARGRACIA

title: Great time at gaudi house.
text: Had a great time and experience at the gaudi house in Barcelona. Would recommend to friends and family.
author: marlenebH5357XN

title: Amazing experience
text: Excellent tour and wonderful guide.  Learnt heaps !  Tour guide had so much knowledge    Still lots to learn next visit
author: AnneLill_H

title: Victoria gave us an...
text: Victoria gave us an excellent tour of the Gaudí houses. There is a lot of walking. Our guide took us on the subway to see the last house- Casa Vicens. I was glad that this tour included tickets to La Predera and casa  Vicens.
author: Ann_J

title: Fascinating walk through...
text: Fascinating walk through the neighborhoods of Barcelona. Our guide Victoria was very knowledgeable and passionate about Gaudi and the city.
author: Alan_P

title: Great tour and tour guide
text: Victoria did an excellent job showing us Gaudi homes and explaining unique features. She was very conversational and told us a lot about Barcelona in general. She was personable and flexible.
author: Jet63315

title: A very pleasant experience
text: Oriol our guide is a super recommended person, the explanation he gave us during the day was the best, his recommendations and typical during the tour are invaluable very friendly and with a lot of knowledge of the history of the city and Gaudí.
author: Edgar_C

title: Gaudi private tour
text: Very good tour. Pedro was excellent. Rain didn't bother us at all. Gaudi houses and the walking tour were excellent.
author: Red_V

title: You have to take this tour!
text: Amazing tour and should NOT be missed! Horatio was incredibly knowledgeable and gave us important background on Barcelona that enhance our experience tremendously.
author: elvin_r

title: Ties the Gaudi experience...
text: Ties the Gaudi experience together from beginning to end of his architectural expression evident in these fabulous houses. The guide provided rich biographical and historical context. There’s more of Gaudi to visit than the Cathedral.
author: Pat_S
